We must have our minds sealed by יהוה
We must obey The Torah of יהוה in its Spiritual Intent
We must express our faith in Yahushua as The Pesach (Passover) Lamb
We must be Mikvah’d (Baptized/Immersed)
We must walk in the example set by Yahushua
We must display the Sign of the sons of יהוה - The Shabbath
We must keep Pesach “in remembrance” of Yahushua
We must have the same testimony יהוה gave Yahushua
We must boldly defend and protect The Torah and Prophets
We must boldly declare our birthright as sons of יהוה
We must learn to righteously judge according to His Torah/Law
We must submit our lives to יהוה
We must give this life up
We must keep all the Festivals of יהוה

You do well. The demons also believe – and shudder! 20 But do you wish to know, O foolish man, that the belief without the works is dead? 21 Was not Abvraham our father declared right by works when he offered Yitcsḥaq his son on the altar? 22 Do you see that the belief was working with his works, and by the works the belief was perfected? 23 And the Scripture was filled which says, “Abvraham believed Elohim, and it was reckoned to him for righteousness.” And he was called, “Elohim’s friend.” 24 You see, then, that a man is declared right by works, and not by belief alone. 25 In the same way, was not Raḥaḇ the whore also declared right by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way? 26 For as the body without the spirit is dead, so also the belief is dead without the works.

blocks.html: We should observe these Festivals as they were given to us by Him to impart essential spiritual insights. If people had continued to observe the Festivals of יהוה, they would not have been deceived by the "False Messiah/Jesus" who did away with the Torah.
